title: Minister Anand meets with EU High Representative Kaja Kallas in Montréal
excerpt: The officials discussed the Canada-EU strategic partnership and support for Ukraine ahead of the 21st Canada-EU Summit.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced that Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand met with Kaja Kallas, High Representative of the European Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission, on October 29, 2026. The meeting occurred in Montréal, Quebec, on the eve of the 21st Canada-EU Summit.

During the meeting, the officials took stock of progress made since the June 2025 Summit regarding the New EU-Canada Strategic Partnership of the Future and the security and defence partnership. They also discussed the benefits of the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement, which the government describes as a cornerstone of the Canada-EU relationship. Additionally, the officials welcomed the signing of the Canada-EU Host Country Agreement.

Minister Anand and High Representative Kallas reiterated their unwavering support for Ukraine’s sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity. They emphasized the importance of sustaining international support for Ukraine and of increasing pressure on Russia, including by ensuring that it is held accountable. The officials also discussed other shared geopolitical priorities, including the situation in the Middle East, and agreed to remain in close contact.
